data.title: Call with The Meridian Dispatch
data.transcript: Speaker 1: Freya Aldous here, I edit The Meridian Dispatch. Your note on meteor showers would suit the December issue. Speaker 2: I'd be glad to write it. Speaker 1: Eight hundred words, and I need it by the 25th to lay out the issue. Speaker 2: You'll have it by the 25th. Speaker 1: If you have a photo of the Perseids, we'd run it. Speaker 2: The best one is the astronomy club photographer's; I'll ask her if we can use it.
